definitions.explanation: A male sibling who is younger than oneself. Used for both one's own younger brother and others' younger brothers.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{高校生|こうこうせい}です。
examples.english: My younger brother is a high school student.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{遊|あそ}びました。
examples.english: I played with my younger brother.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{私|わたし}より5{歳|さい}{年下|としした}です。
examples.english: My younger brother is 5 years younger than me.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{毎日|まいにち}サッカーの{練習|れんしゅう}をしています。{将来|しょうらい}、プロになりたいそうです。
examples.english: My younger brother practices soccer every day. He says he wants to become a pro in the future.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}が{小|ちい}さい{時|とき}、{私|わたし}がよく{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}ていました。{今|いま}では{弟|おとうと}の{方|ほう}が{背|せ}が{高|たか}いです。
examples.english: When my younger brother was small, I often took care of him. Now he's taller than me.

notes:
Unlike older siblings, the humble/polite distinction is less strict for younger siblings. {弟|おとうと}さん is used to refer to someone else's younger brother politely.

Related: {妹|いもうと} (younger sister).
